Parque das Nações — Lisbon, Portugal

🟡 Local-source safety assessment · 24 areas reviewed individually Methodology →

Relatively safer day Average night

In detail

Contrary to its upscale, purpose-built reputation, real press coverage does document property-crime concerns here, though not street violence affecting pedestrians by day. Correio da Manhã ran the headline "Assaltos afligem Parque das Nações" and separately reported a burglar couple caught on camera in the district. CNN Portugal (9 Feb 2024) reported a kidnapping, threats and robbery case in Parque das Nações resulting in two PSP arrests. High-value home burglaries (including a widely covered €500k cash-and-jewellery theft, Aug 2026) have also been reported in Lisbon's affluent districts, of which this is one. No daytime street-crime pattern was found in coverage, so day is rated green. Sources checked: Correio da Manhã – "Assaltos afligem Parque das Nações"; Correio da Manhã – "Casal assaltante do Parque das Nações apanhado pelas câmaras"; CNN Portugal, 9 Feb 2024 – "Sequestro, ameaças e roubo no Parque das Nações. PSP detém dois suspeitos"; Observador, 6 Aug 2026 – "Assalto a casa em Lisboa rende meio milhão de euros em dinheiro e joias. Suspeitos estarão em fuga".

Frequently asked questions

Is Parque das Nações safe?

Wandroz currently rates Parque das Nações in Lisbon as relatively safer than most other neighbourhoods in Lisbon during the day and roughly average compared to other neighbourhoods in Lisbon at night. This comes from a structured local-source assessment: an area-level review of credible local sources — local and national news, municipal and police-published material, and official surveys where they exist — consolidated across sources rather than taken from a single report. Lisbon publishes no comparable neighbourhood-level crime dataset; where a city does, Wandroz uses it instead.

Is Parque das Nações safe at night?

At night, Parque das Nações is rated as roughly average compared to other neighbourhoods in Lisbon. If you're unsure, it's worth checking recent local reviews for your specific street or block, since a neighbourhood-wide rating can't capture block-by-block variation.

Is Parque das Nações a good area to stay in as a tourist?

Parque das Nações's day rating (relatively safer than most other neighbourhoods in Lisbon) is the more relevant one for typical daytime tourist activity; check the night rating too if you'll be out late.
